novel_reason: Needs unused quote turnover as a 20-bar high, then a fade when that climax bar breaks the 20-bar price high and closes in the lower 20% (SHORT) or breaks the 20-bar low and closes in the upper 20% (LONG). Climax + rejection. Not volume_climax_fade. Not bar_vwap_inflow_surge. Not up_down_turnover_imbalance.
summary: Fade a quote-turnover climax whose close rejects the 20-bar extreme.
justification: A 20-bar turnover climax with a rejected close is not an RSI volume-climax fade and not a follow-the-money imbalance.
